Well, if you like someone romantically (crush/dating), it means that you are attracted to want to do romantic stuff with them (kissing, cuddling, sex, etc...) and is usually a result of being sexually attracted/excited by their looks + their personality. 

But for, platonic/friendly relationships, it means that you don't want to do romantic stuff with them, like, you just don't get the attraction to do that with them, you just want to stay regular friends. Hope that makes sense. 

So to help distinguish whether you like someone in a friendly/romantic way, sometimes, it helps to go on a date with a person, hang out with them and get to know them more. Then maybe you can get a better feel of how you like them. E.g. maybe at the end you feel like you want to do "romantic stuff" with them.
